scope: CBE forward geometry and both curvature producers; selected HBQ arc/track intent. Not a complete controller review or parity claim.

rangesReviewed: 2525-2553 measured chord curvature and direction reset
1197-1241 reverse traffic ray selection, separate remaining work
reference.intent: Predict a bounded measured bend then continue tangentially. Native forward/reverse traffic direction is a separate branch. Source model-space point conversion is not a licence to mix metre-based distances with scaled coordinates. Protected source unchanged.

finding: Forward probes passed metre horizons/contact margins through a native model transform that includes scale. Support-height thresholds and both curvature producers also used scaled inverse model coordinates. For a fixed physical chord, old inverse-model curvature changes by scale and its displacement threshold is no longer three metres. Fixing only the final probe would leave its two hints inconsistent.
implementation: DrivingGeometryCap projects the actual hull once into unit body side/forward/up axes using DrivingHullInterval. Straight and curved stations, contact probes and support-height comparisons use rigid metre arithmetic. Pitch/roll remain body-oriented; real hull size scales once. Shared 0.05 m outward padding remains.

DrivingTurnTrack projects the actual travelled chord onto unit body axes and reads actual velocity in that frame. Existing 3 m/1.5 s/6 s thresholds, reversal/standing reset and straightness policy remain. Its private measurement identity adds BODY_METRES so an older scaled hint cannot be retained across a live source reload; four-field receipt and caller authority remain.

DrivingNativePathWatch projects the final fresh nearby target into the same unit body axes before its forward threshold and inverse-metre curvature. Existing path subscription, route/seat/owner binding, 64 nodes, floor checks, 3..12 m range, six-metre walk and evidence ages remain.

Unavailable pose, hull or motion returns a zero solid UNAVAILABLE constraint with no gate/target. Ordinary and convoy consumers preserve their existing zero-cap sentinel handling. Bypass PLAN requires a nonnull STATIC object, so this observation cannot propose a bypass.
No native movement writer, setting, helper prop, world query, ray, worker, timer or restoration policy added. No source original edited.
boundedCost: Geometry uses one origin plus the shared four native hull transforms, then basis arithmetic rather than native transforms at each straight/curved/contact point and inverse support comparison. The two hint producers add unit-basis arithmetic and remove scaled inverse conversion. Existing ray/hit counts and owner callbacks remain. Runtime median/p95 is unmeasured; fewer native transforms is not an FPS claim.

validation.existingRegressionExtension: Independent rigid-frame oracle for scale 0.5/1/2, pitch/roll, fixed horizon/contact distance, support threshold and arc chord; scale-dependent old curvature and original observation/authority bounds remain covered.

remaining: Ordinary autonomous reversing currently enters forward-only traffic/geometry observation unless CBE owns a dedicated reverse leg. The pedestrian observer already has direction handling. A coherent rear-traffic intent/hold treatment remains required; blindly retaining an old reverse flag cannot authorise movement after a changed native order.
HBQ precision/player-distance observation LOD, complete controller handovers and wider source integration remain unfinished.
Physical slopes, corners, decks, supported scaling, actual braking/flow, normal-HC repeats and 5 percent median/10 percent p95 performance require runtime evidence. Audits remain paused.
